$comment: The command surface of pkinative-cli 1.0.0, projected from its own capability manifest (`pkinative schema manifest`) by scripts/build-cli-surface.ts — never hand-edited. The per-command report and summary JSON Schemas are left out: `pkinative schema report <command> [<sub>]` serves them. cli-surface-parity holds the CLI guide and the command builder to this file.

errorClasses.meaning: A flag, argument or option value is missing or invalid (exit 2).
A value you supplied is not acceptable: a spec document, a label, a range, a key that does not match.
The bytes are not the DER, PEM or JSON structure they claim to be.
A filesystem or stream failure, including a refused overwrite.
A security policy refused the input: SHA-1 without --allow-sha1, PBES1, a legacy PKCS#12 MAC.
A named bound was exceeded: one of the 22 pkinative limits, or --max-content-size.
The runtime or pkinative does not support the algorithm, key or structure.
Web Crypto could not run the operation the input requires.
A password is wrong, or a MAC does not match it.
A named item does not exist: an extension, a PEM block, a signer, a code.
A signature, chain, request, time-stamp or MAC verdict is negative; the report says why.
A check returned reasons (revocation, OCSP, name, purpose) or --strict escalated a warning.
Anything else (exit 1); PKINATIVE_DEBUG=1 prints the stack.
